semantics.mechanism: Combines S9 MTF-trend context with an S1-style sweep or breakout trigger — a non-arbitrary composite. Loser = counter-trend sweep faders.
semantics.signal_reason: 4H trend context plus a sweep (or breakout onset) of the `lb`-bar extreme in the trend direction; enter next open.

entry.description: H4 trend up + fresh onset of a close above the 20-bar rolling high.
